review_method.source_comparison: Compared the source image with decoded frames at 0.1, 2.5 and 4.9 seconds and with a five-frame contact sheet.
review_method.technical_verification: Rechecked the recorded ffprobe dimensions, duration, frame count, frame rate and audio presence.

observations.requested_motion: The purple aura around the progesterone molecule should continuously contract and lose intensity, ending as a small faint halo while every other infographic element remains unchanged.
observations.camera: Fixed camera and full square framing throughout.
invariant_failures: The purple aura expands and darkens into a large field around the midpoint before shrinking, instead of continuously receding and dimming.
The battery changes from a low red charge to an almost full red charge.
The scale needle shifts during the clip.
The arrow from the ovaries to the molecule turns purple around the midpoint.
The provider added an audio track despite generate_audio=false and returned 1440x1440 instead of the requested 1080p route contract.

verdict.summary: The output preserves readable labels and overall layout, but the aura first grows dramatically and unrelated infographic states also animate; it therefore fails the requested isolated continuous contraction.
